_: The Elder Dragon Gods' voices (docs/VOICES.md, The gods). Each is one of the CustomVoice model's own speakers under one description, as the owner's approved samples were made (refs/). Change a word here and every line of that god must be recorded again. style: what style.py does to every take, the owner's approved treatment (no echo, no reverb, no drive, no growl).
_sampling: Calm sampling, as Lisandra's (tools/voice/anchors.json): takes 10 and up. Takes 0-9 were made at the model's defaults, which wander in pitch from take to take.
_textOnly: The critics' round-2 rewrites: a line here with no take passing every rule gets no recording and is shown, not said.

thyrraxis.speaker: aiden
thyrraxis.who: An ancient dragon god of storms, male. A huge, deep, resonant voice with a cultivated southern English accent, received pronunciation. Proud, amused and contemptuous, speaking slowly and with relish, from deep in the chest. Each sentence falls at its end.
thyrraxis.sample: Small things, crossing my sky on a thread of stone. Do you know how far down the bottom is?

kaldurra.speaker: serena
kaldurra.who: An ancient dragon goddess of fire, female. A deep, low, smouldering contralto with a cultivated southern English accent, received pronunciation. Regal, warm and terrible, speaking slowly, from deep in the chest. Each sentence falls at its end.
kaldurra.sample: The fire walks. You will run out of island before it runs out of hunger.

morvekh.speaker: eric
morvekh.who: A dead dragon god of ice, male, impossibly old. A hollow, dry, cold voice, very low and rasping, with a cultivated southern English accent, received pronunciation. Dead calm and patient, speaking slowly and quietly. Each sentence falls at its end.
morvekh.sample: Stand behind your friends. They are colder than you now.

nihvaroth.speaker: ryan
nihvaroth.who: A god that is a black hole, male. A vast, very deep, empty bass voice with a cultivated southern English accent, received pronunciation. Without feeling, calm and unhurried, speaking very slowly. Each sentence falls at its end.
nihvaroth.sample: I am the hunger under the stars. The other three were only my teeth.
